item.title: Syria's integration deal with SDF to take effect on Monday
item.description: YPG terror group-led SDF members are to be integrated individually into military brigades under the Ministry of Defence from Monday.

item.title: UN warns winter turning deadly in Gaza after claiming lives of 11 children
item.description: UN spokesperson Farhan Haq says tents provide limited protection to Palestinian families during the winter.

item.title: Anti-ICE protests sweep US cities as DOJ opens probe into Pretti killing
item.description: Tens of thousands join marches and boycotts across the United States to protest President Trump's "Operation Metro Surge."

item.title: Trump administration approves $6.67B arms sale to Israel amid heightened Middle East tensions
item.description: The State Department has approved the sale of 30 Apache attack helicopters and over 3,000 tactical vehicles.

item.title: Trump oil blockade triggers fuel crisis across Cuba
item.description: Long queues form at petrol stations as Washington targets countries supplying oil to Cuba.

item.title: US CENTCOM warns it won't 'tolerate unsafe' actions by Iran's Revolutionary Guard
item.description: Central Command warns that "any unsafe and unprofessional behaviour near US forces, regional partners or commercial vessels increases risks of collision, escalation, and destabilisation."

item.title: Former Israeli PM stayed multiple times at Epstein's New York apartment, newly released pages show
item.description: US Justice Department files show former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak and his wife stayed multiple times at Jeffrey Epstein's New York flat.

item.title: US Senate passes government funding package as shutdown set to take effect
item.description: A partial shutdown is still set to begin Saturday as the House of Representatives is out of session until Monday.

item.title: Venezuela’s acting president proposes sweeping amnesty for political prisoners
item.description: Acting president Delcy Rodriguez has announced plans for a sweeping amnesty covering decades of political violence, alongside judicial reforms and prison closures.

item.title: US government temporarily shuts down
item.description: A House delay leaves Washington bracing for a brief shutdown despite the Senate's backing of a stopgap funding bill.
